barbican_service_name.description: The name of the OpenStack service (used in logs and service registration).

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging for troubleshooting.

user.description: System user account under which the Barbican API process runs.

group.description: System group for the Barbican API process.

state_path.description: Base directory for runtime data (e.g., encryption keys, temporary files).

api_bind_host.description: IP address the Barbican API server binds to (e.g., 127.0.0.1 for localhost only).

api_bind_port.description: TCP port the Barbican API server listens on.

enable_v1_api.description: Enable the legacy v1 API endpoint (recommended to keep enabled for compatibility).

items.description: Allowed origin URLs for CORS requests (e.g., https://horizon.example.com).

cors_allowed_origins.description: List of domains allowed to make cross-origin requests to the API.

auth_strategy.description: Authentication strategy. Use 'keystone' for production; 'noauth' only for testing.

keystone_public_endpoint.description: Public endpoint URL for the Keystone service (used in token introspection and self-service links).

keystone_project_domain_name.description: Keystone domain name containing the Barbican service project.

keystone_project_name.description: Keystone project (tenant) name for the Barbican service user.

keystone_user_domain_name.description: Keystone domain name containing the Barbican service user.

keystone_username.description: Keystone username for the Barbican service.

keystone_password.description: Password for the Barbican Keystone service user — *must* be set securely (e.g., via secret manager or env override).

db_max_pool_size.description: Maximum number of idle database connections in the pool.

db_max_overflow.description: Maximum number of additional connections allowed beyond pool size.

secretstore_plugin.description: Secret storage plugin to use. 'store_crypto' provides local encrypted storage.

store_crypto_key.description: Base64-encoded 256-bit AES key used to encrypt secrets at rest. *Must* be at least 256 bits and kept secure (e.g., via key rotation).

store_crypto_key_wrap.description: Key wrapping algorithm for storing secrets (e.g., 'AES_WRAP', 'RSA_PKCS1v15').

worker_processes.description: Number of Gunicorn worker processes (increase under high concurrency).

worker_threads.description: Number of threads per worker (set >1 for I/O-bound workloads).

worker_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for requests before timing out (increase for slow key generation).

worker_access_log.description: Path to access log file (use '-' to log to stdout).

worker_access_log_format.description: Format string for access logs (Apache Common Log Format style).

disable_private_key_export.description: If true, private keys (e.g., for RSA) cannot be exported — recommended for security.

max_secret_data_size.description: Maximum size (bytes) of secret data allowed per secret (security hardening to limit memory usage).
